article.story: Florida A&M Rattlers (0-3) vs. UMKC Roos (1-2) St. Petersburg, Florida; Wednesday, 12 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: UMKC will play Florida A&M at McArthur Center in St. Petersburg, Florida. UMKC finished 4-27 overall with a 3-13 record in non-conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Roos averaged 69.3 points per game while allowing opponents to score 83.9 last season. Florida A&M finished 15-16 overall with a 3-8 record in non-conference games in the 2025-26 season.
